title: Calculus: Change and Accumulation
description: Bring points together, trace a tangent and build an area. Discover how change accumulates.
audience: An adult comfortable with algebra, function notation, powers and coordinate graphs. This introductory course develops polynomial limits, rates and accumulation.

modules.title: Approach a point
modules.summary: Limits, continuity and the first derivative.

concepts.title: What happens near the gap?
concepts.summary: Separate the value approached near a point from the value assigned at the point.

concepts.title: Do both sides meet?
concepts.summary: Use one-sided limits and the value at the point to decide continuity.

concepts.title: Zoom in on a rate
concepts.summary: Turn average rates over an interval into a derivative at a point.
